title: Mixed Event — Imprisoned Marionette — Episode8 Even Though I Don't Know

meta.Episode: Episode8 — Even Though I Don't Know
meta.Event Outline: To fulfill her promise to Mafuyu, Kanade wants to learn more about her. Meanwhile, the group visits a doll exhibit, where Mafuyu has a strange experience.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because it's completely different from your usual stuff! It's not like OWN either and... It just feels so alive!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's like I'm seeing a part of Yuki I've never seen before!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yes, it really is very different from before...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's so annoying that she can write something like this too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, may I turn this into a song?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I want to make music for these lyrics right now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Me too! It'll be fun to make a music video for this! Right, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wow, Enanan's being compliant? You're full of surprises!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Because if I say no, you'll go on and on about my prickly exterior and whatnot again, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'll write a song that's perfect for these lyrics, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I think it's amazing! This wasn't the kind of song I was expecting to come out from those lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's like moody pop music and that's incredibly cute! You really outdid yourself, K!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But... There's a dull pain in my heart...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It hurts, but... It's not nearly as bad as the pain I felt before when I went to SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I didn't know my lyrics could turn into a song like this.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, you said before that you can't feel or understand happiness and joy. But I have a different opinion.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think that you've probably convinced yourself that you just can't.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How else would you be able to write lyrics like these?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So maybe it's better for you to express yourself more openly!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Try expressing your feelings in different ways, like through your lyrics this time... Maybe you could express yourself through art like Enanan too!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, the best way is still to say it out loud, but some things just can't be put into words.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So if you feel something, anything at all, just be honest and spit it all out! Think you can try doing that?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <At least when you're with us, you know...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That would be a lot better than awkward silence.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Enanan, couldn't you say that a little nicer?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The better we can understand your feelings, the closer we'll be to making a song that can save you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You may even find your true self in the process.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't know if I can actually do that, but I'll try...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If that's so... Maybe, just maybe, I'll be able to find it after all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The coloring makes this illustration look filthy.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now look here! I deliberately chose that color theme because the picture's supposed to portray a messy sort of atmosphere!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <This line here is crooked and it bothers me.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <This expression on this person is really beautiful. I think it goes well with the song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Oh, well... I spent the most time on that part, so... Of course?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But it feels off-balance on the whole.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What's your problem?!
Why do you keep picking on me?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm just expressing what I feel out loud.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You two told her to be honest with whatever's on her mind and this is what she's like now! I'm holding you responsible for everything she says from now on!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, this is like rehab in a way so...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The effects in the MV during the chorus hurt my eyes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, it hits hard when she dishes it out like that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm enjoying myself right now. What about you?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm still not sure... But I think I may be feeling the same way too.>
